blinding_contract: Teacher phrases were committed before any rank-101-200 evaluation query was authored or committed. Do not alter phrases in response to evaluation output.
target_boundary: Exactly frozen P80 skill ranks 101-200; disjoint by target identity from the earlier model-authored top-100 suite.
runtime_boundary: Build-time enrichment only. Production inference remains deterministic frontend BM25/postings; no model inference or API.
interpretation_boundary: Synthetic teacher evidence may establish representational capacity and generalization across a prefrozen synthetic target/query split, but is not independent user evidence or canonical taxonomy truth.
